headline: Shin Ohashi sets 200m breaststroke world record at the Asian Games

supports: Japan's Shin Ohashi won the men's 200m breaststroke at the Asian Games in 2:04.83.
The time set a world record, improving on Qin Haiyang's previous 2:05.48 mark.
Ohashi is 17 years old and represented Japan at the Asian Games.
He recorded 2:04.83 in the men's 200m breaststroke, ahead of the former world-record time of 2:05.48.
